bluejetty:00028714:ios.description:
Organize fast and flexible Round Robin tournaments.
This app handles player distribution, court assignments and match generation automatically, so you can focus on playing instead of planning.
Enter the players, choose your format, select the number of courts and start the tournament. The app creates all rounds needed and ensures that everyone plays fair and balanced matches.
Included Formats
Round Robin Singles
Every player meets all other players once. Perfect for single player rotation.
Round Robin Doubles, Fixed Teams
Set predefined teams and let every team face each other once.
Round Robin Doubles, Random Teams (Americano)
All players are paired with everyone else one time. Full coverage without repeats.
Mixed Round Robin
Teams are automatically formed with one woman and one man per team.
Unlimited Doubles
Players can join or leave at any time. Rounds are generated continuously and sit-outs are evenly distributed. Ideal for spontaneous or shifting groups.
Mexicano
Matches are generated based on the current leaderboard so that players meet opponents of similar level. Creates balanced rounds throughout the tournament.
Mixicano
The same matchmaking logic as Mexicano, but every team always contains one man and one woman.
Super Mexicano
Mexicano with an additional scoring system where players earn extra points depending on how close they are to the winning court.
Team Mexicano
Mexicano played with fixed teams instead of rotating partners.
Club Team Round Robin
Players are divided into two teams and face each other over multiple courts using balanced matchups.
Beat the Box
Players start on assigned courts, play three matches, then move to new courts based on performance. Supports 8, 12 or 16 players.
Group Stages – Doubles
Create multiple groups where each group plays its own doubles Round Robin. Every player partners with all others inside the group.
Group Stages – Teams
Organize team-based group play where every team meets all other teams in the group.
Champions League
Play a structured format with up to 36 teams split into groups and subsequent knockout-style play.
Highlights
• Automatic generation of balanced rounds
• Support for many tournament structures and group sizes
• Intelligent court assignment
• Tools for managing player lists and bulk adding names
• Designed for both casual play and organized club events
Whether you run a weekly club session or arrange a larger event, this app gives you a complete and flexible toolkit for Round Robin-based formats.
Terms of Use: https://perkodar.se/terms

bluejetty:00045221:ios.description:
Fox Rehab app facilitates Fox users by allowing them to send referral orders straight from mobile app. Users can scan the referral document or fill the required information and upload it, where it will be processed and will be assigned by supervisor to an indexer. Major Features of Fox app are as:
- Send referral orders on the go.
- Scan and auto detect document and take picture of it.
- Multiple Documents can be uploaded for a single referral.
- Add patient Insurance and address.
- Add patient diagnosis in referral.
- Add procedure information in the referral.
- Create new patient or update patient demographics.
- Manually create the referral, view the final draft and sign it.
- Send message to your fellow colleagues or referral source.
- Create group chat with other users.
Fox Trax for Regional Directors:
Regional Directors can manage their region cases and clinicians using Fox Trax app. 
Regional Directors can do following using app
- View pending assignments of their assigned regions.
- Assign a case to a clinician based on smart suggestion by app.
- Hold a pending assignment case for later assignment.
- View case details and case history for more information.
- View and add notes for particular client.
- Ability to extend the hold on a case.
- Reassign a case to some other clinician.
- Add treatment team member to a cases.
- View the schedule of an assigned clinician.
- View the appointment history of an active client.
- View open issues relevant to a case.
- View and comment on the tasks assigned to them or their region.
- Approve or deny PTO requests.
- Reassign the void appointments during clinician PTO to other clinicians.
- Approve appointment reassign requests by the clinicians.
- View and update their regions clinician information.
Fox Trax for Account Managers:
Account Managers can do following using app
- Account Managers can view pending assignments of their assigned regions.
- Account Managers can view and update patient notes.
- Account Managers can view case details.
- Account Managers can view On Hold cases of their assigned regions.
- Account Managers can view active cases of their region.
- Account Managers can view appointment history of active cases.
- Account Managers can view discharged cases of their region.
- Account Managers have the ability to view and update the tasks assigned to them.
- Account Managers can view open issues of their assigned regions.
- Account Managers can view the Non Admit cases of their region.
- Account Managers can view clinicians and their details for their assigned regions.

bluejetty:00015311:ios.name: Ice Cream Truck: Dessert Sim
bluejetty:00015311:ios.summary:
Build Your Dream Ice Cream Truck and Explore the Town!
Dive into the world of dessert logistics. From assembling the nuts and bolts of your truck to managing fruit inventory, this app offers a complete tycoon experience.
[Language: Tradit
bluejetty:00015311:ios.description:
Build Your Dream Ice Cream Truck and Explore the Town!
Dive into the world of dessert logistics. From assembling the nuts and bolts of your truck to managing fruit inventory, this app offers a complete tycoon experience.
[Language: Traditional Chinese] 
This app features Traditional Chinese text and voiceovers.
Visual Learning: Explore the detailed anatomy of an ice cream truck.
Structure Recognition: Learn the specific terms for vehicle parts (like the "Window Awning" or "Rooftop Cone") with clear Traditional Chinese labels.
[Game Features] 
● Factory Simulation: Start from scratch in the "Car Maker" workshop. Assemble the chassis, body, and decorative elements to build a functional vehicle.
● Inventory Management: Visit the Fruit Market and Candy Shop to stock up on fresh ingredients like apples, strawberries, and candies. Unlock new items as you progress!
● Creative Design: Customize your truck with unique patterns, colors, and toppings. Make it stand out in the neighborhood.
● Business Tycoon: Drive your finished truck to the town, park perfectly, and serve soft-serve ice cream to waiting customers.
● Immersive Audio: Enjoy realistic sound effects and Traditional Chinese voice prompts.
[How to Play]
Assembly: Drag and drop parts to construct the truck. Watch as the Chinese labels appear to teach you the structure names.
Shopping: Purchase necessary ingredients from the store using your checklist.
Decoration: Apply your favorite theme to the vehicle.
Service: Drive to the destination and start your sales!
Download now and start your engine! The sweetest adventure awaits.
Contact us:
E-mail: support@iappsteam.com
Website: http://www.iappsteam.com

bluejetty:00017223:ios.description:
Have fun and train your brain with one of the most downloaded sudoku apps in the AppStore! Millions of people play sudoku daily and it’s truly a game for everyone! The Sudoku.com app has thousands of classic sudoku puzzles to help you keep your brain active, unwind from stress or relax. Install to play now!
Classic sudoku for beginners and advanced players. Whether you'd like to relax or keep your mind active – pass the time in a pleasant way! Get a short stimulating break and clear your head with Sudoku.com. Take your favorite game with you wherever you go. Playing Sudoku.com on mobile is as good as with a pencil and paper.
Choose any level you like. Play easier levels to challenge your brain, or try expert levels to give your mind a real workout. Sudoku.com has some features that make the game easier for you: hints, auto-check, and highlighted duplicates. You can use them, or complete the challenge without their help – it's totally up to you! What's more, in Sudoku.com each puzzle has one solution.
Get an amazing sudoku experience:
· Take notes to keep track of possible numbers. Every time you fill in a cell, your notes are automatically updated!
· Hints can guide you when you get stuck
· Complete Daily Challenges and get unique trophies
· Take part in Seasonal Events and win unique medals 
· View Statistics and track your progress
· Challenge yourself and figure out your mistakes, or enable Auto-Check to see your mistakes as you go
· Highlight duplicates to avoid repeating numbers in a row, column or block
· Express yourself with funny ninja stickers for iMessage!
Challenge your brain with Sudoku.com anywhere, anytime!

bluejetty:00029364:ios.name: AirDroid Cast-screen mirroring
bluejetty:00029364:ios.summary: AirDroid Cast is a cross-platform screen mirroring app. It offers seamless screen mirroring via USB / AirPlay / wireless local and remote network, for all devices, including iOS, ,Windows, and Mac. You can share up to 5 screens simultaneous
bluejetty:00029364:ios.description:
AirDroid Cast is a cross-platform screen mirroring app. It offers seamless screen mirroring via USB / AirPlay / wireless local and remote network, for all devices, including iOS, ,Windows, and Mac. You can share up to 5 screens simultaneously, and remote control the mobile is supported.
AirDroid Cast also has a web version: webcast.airdroid.com, enabling screen sharing to any browser without requiring installation on the receiving device.
>>>Key Features of AirDroid Cast 
-Cross-platform Screen Casting
This screencasting app is compatible with multiple systems, including iPhone, Windows, and Mac. Supporting screen mirroring from your iPhone/Mac/Windows to your computer or vice versa without hassle. 
-Connect Devices wirelessly or via a USB cable
This app offers you three distinct connection options: wireless, AirPlay, or USB cable. Connect your devices in a way that works best for you. 
-Mirror the Screen Remotely with Ease
AirDroid Cast also works seamlessly in remote networks, providing greater accessibility for remote collaboration. It enables you to effortlessly share your screen with colleagues from afar, making it easier to collaborate on projects, provide feedback, and make changes in real time.
-Control Mobile Devices from Computer
With its Control feature, you will fully control your iOS device (iPhone/iPad) screen from a laptop or computer. It helps to relax your hand by not having to hold your phone all the time.
AirDroid Cast supports casting a maximum of five devices onto a single screen simultaneously, making it ideal for businesses or individuals who need to multitask efficiently.
>>>Perfect for Various Screen Mirroring Occasions 
-Personal use 
-Business Meeting 
-Online class/Education 
-Live streaming 
-Movies/Sports video mirroring 
-Presentation 
-Gaming 
-Work from home 
>>> Payment 
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase 
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period 
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. The cost depends on the selected plan 
- The user may manage subscriptions, and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase 
- Any unused portion of the free trial will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription 
> >>Feedback: 
For any further suggestions or questions, please feel free to contact us at support@airdroid.com
Privacy Policy: https://cast.airdroid.info/#/Privacy
EULA: https://cast.airdroid.info/#/Eula
Payment Terms: https://cast.airdroid.info/#/Payment

bluejetty:00022109:ios.name: Drum Notation by Beat Note
bluejetty:00022109:ios.summary:
Beat Note — Drum Notation for Drummers, Teachers, and Content Creators
The fastest way to write, hear, practice, and share drum notation. Built by a drummer, for drummers.
FOR DRUMMERS — FROM YOUR HEAD TO THE PAGE IN SECONDS
You have a
bluejetty:00022109:ios.description:
Beat Note — Drum Notation for Drummers, Teachers, and Content Creators
The fastest way to write, hear, practice, and share drum notation. Built by a drummer, for drummers.
FOR DRUMMERS — FROM YOUR HEAD TO THE PAGE IN SECONDS
You have a groove idea. Beat Note gets it down before you lose it.
Tap the sequencer grid to build beats. Watch them turn into clean, professional drum notation in real time. Hit play and hear exactly what you wrote — at any tempo, with a click track, on loop.
- Transcribe songs to check your ear and lock in what you hear
- Compose your own grooves, fills, and exercises from scratch
- Count in with a visual on-screen "1, 2, 3, 4" so your eyes and ears are ready together
- Use Beat Note as your in-ear metronome during rehearsals — your beats, not just clicks
"Been waiting a long time for an app like this. Clearly built by a drummer." — App Store review
FOR TEACHERS — WRITE IT, PLAY IT, SEND IT
What used to take 30 minutes in a desktop notation program now takes 2 minutes on your phone or iPad.
Write exercises on the fly — during the lesson, not after it. Play back the notation so students hear exactly how it should sound. Share a link so they can listen at home. Export a PDF they can print and bring to the kit.
- Use the sequencer as a live music whiteboard, in person or online
- Build a library of exercises organized by tag, ready for any student
- Send a shareable link or export a high-quality PDF in one tap
"What would normally take 30 minutes on a computer has become 2 minutes from my mobile device. My students love it." — App Store review
FOR CONTENT CREATORS — PROFESSIONAL NOTATION VIDEOS, IN MINUTES
Export your beat as an animated MP4 — portrait for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts, or landscape for YouTube and Vimeo. Choose 720p, 1080p, or 4K. Pick a color theme. Preview before you export.
PDF, PNG, WAV or AAC audio, shareable link, and animated MP4 — all from one app.
NOTATION THAT LOOKS RIGHT
Professional drum notation, consistent across every format you export. What you see on screen is what your students get in the PDF, what your followers see in the video, and what you hear in playback.
- All standard drums, cymbals, and articulations
- Subdivisions from 8th notes to 32nd notes, plus triplets, quintuplets (5s), and septuplets (7s)
- Common and compound time signatures, including 6/8, 9/8, and 12/8
- Linear, split hands/feet, or split drums/cymbals voicing
- Sticking annotations (R, L)
- Single-measure repeat symbol (%) — renders automatically when measures repeat
ORGANIZE AND DISCOVER
- Tags, search, and sort to manage your beat library
- Discover tab: curated educational beats for all skill levels
- Beat templates to get started fast
- Customize tempo, click track, count-in, and timer
MADE BY A DRUMMER, SHAPED BY THE COMMUNITY
Beat Note was built by me — an independent developer with 35+ years behind the kit. But the direction comes from the community. Every major feature on the roadmap has been voted on, requested, and refined by drummers, teachers, and creators just like you.
Join the conversation at roadmap.beat-note.app — vote on upcoming features, share ideas, and see what's coming next. I'm here to make sure it all comes together into something that actually works.
Premium subscription required for full access. Educator and Creator tiers available. Free trial included.
Payment is charged through your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription auto-renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period via iTunes Account Settings.
Terms and Privacy Policy: https://www.beat-note.app/privacy-and-terms

bluejetty:00028699:ios.summary: Track the rocket launch schedule on Florida's Space Coast with Space Coast Launches. This app contains the schedule of rocket launches from the Kennedy Space Center and Cape Canaveral Space Force base from organizations like NASA, SpaceX, U
bluejetty:00028699:ios.description:
Track the rocket launch schedule on Florida's Space Coast with Space Coast Launches. This app contains the schedule of rocket launches from the Kennedy Space Center and Cape Canaveral Space Force base from organizations like NASA, SpaceX, ULA and more with a clean and convenient user experience. Receive T-2 hour and T-5 minute launch notifications, live launch feeds, a map of popular viewing locations and rocket experiences on Florida's Space Coast, and much more.
Space Coast Launches will help you make the most of your rocket launch experience. 
This is your one-stop-shop for everything about rocket related in east Florida:
- Learn about all of the exciting upcoming launches from Kennedy Space Center and Cape Canaveral Space Force Station.
- Receive notifications for upcoming launches 24 hours and 5 minutes before countdown.
- Live stream rocket launches in the app.
- Access our exclusive "Ultimate Astronaut Itinerary" to learn about all the unique experiences on Florida's Space Coast that fuel your inner Space Nerd.
- Learn tips and FAQs for watching a launch while you're visiting Florida's Space Coast.
- Find the perfect viewing location with the interactive map.
- Use the AR compass to point you towards the correct launch pad so you don't miss a thing.
- Keep track of how many launches the Space Coast has had this year!

bluejetty:00032825:ios.summary:
AR Draw Sketch is a creative drawing application for iPhone/iPad devices, using augmented reality (AR) technology to turn your ideas into unique works of art.

bluejetty:00032825:ios.description:
AR Draw Sketch is a creative drawing application for iPhone/iPad devices, using augmented reality (AR) technology to turn your ideas into unique works of art.
Convert all beautiful moments into unique works of art with the Draw Sketch app. With AR Draw Sketch, you can express your creativity through various key features:
* Sketch: Allows you to draw freely from real images. You can use your phone's camera to create freehand artwork from real-life images. Draw, sketch, and paint, bringing your artistic visions to life like never before.
* Draw on paper: Transfer an image into line work from a photo or artwork. You place your tracing paper over it and draw the lines that you see. This feature is very useful for beginners learning to draw, helping them practice basic skills such as line drawing, and perspective,...
* Video Recording: Capture your AR artwork in time by capturing snapshots of your creations. Share your unique sketches with friends and social media, showcasing the intersection of your imagination and the real world.
* You can learn from AR Draw Sketch to make art an immersive experience with many different drawing objects:
+ Animals
+ Anime
+ Chibi
+ Doodle
+ Butterfly
+ Learn to Draw
+ For kid 
+ Flowers
+ Nature
+ Vehicle
And more...
Advanced Features:
- Edge size: Adjust the edge size to make your strokes thicker
- Opacity: Make the drawing template more or less transparent
- Start with basic drawing exercises to familiarize yourself with the drawing tools. Experiment with different brushes, colors, and line styles.
* Easy to Use: AR Draw Sketch is designed for artists of all levels. The user-friendly interface ensures a seamless experience, allowing you to focus on your creativity without any technical hurdles.
AR Draw Sketch is an iOS application suitable for all ages, from beginners to professional artists.
-------------Using-------------:
1. Position the phone on a stable stand
2. Open the AR Draw Sketch & Trace app
3. Import or select photos from Art Gallery
4. Convert your photo into a contour sketch
5. Adjust the AR version of the image on canvas or paper
6. Create your own beautiful masterpieces
Try AR Draw Sketch today and explore the exciting world of creativity!
If you find AR Draw Sketch & Trace helpful, please rate us and share the app with your friends. Thank you!

bluejetty:00039517:ios.description:
Number Book: Al-Kashif — identify unknown callers, block spam calls, and filter unwanted SMS before they disturb you.
Stop wondering who's calling. Number Book: Al-Kashif gives you instant caller ID for unknown numbers in Saudi Arabia, a powerful reverse phone lookup, spam call blocking, and a smart SMS filter — all in one app.
FEATURES
UNKNOWN CALLER ID
Instantly see the name behind incoming numbers you don't recognize. Know who's calling before you answer.
REVERSE PHONE LOOKUP
Search any phone number to find the owner's name. A fast reverse number lookup built for Saudi numbers.
SPAM CALL BLOCKING
Automatically block telemarketers, scammers, and nuisance callers so they never disturb you.
SMART SMS FILTER
Detect and filter spam and unwanted text messages before they clutter your inbox.
WHY NUMBER BOOK: AL-KASHIF
- Fast and accurate caller identification for Saudi Arabia
- Clean, simple interface in Arabic and English
- Works in the background so unknown callers are identified automatically
SUBSCRIPTION & PRICING
Number Book: Al-Kashif is free to download. Unlock the full experience with a premium subscription:
- 3-day free trial on the weekly plan
- $4.99 per week
- $29.99 per year
Prices may vary by region.
SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and turn off auto-renewal in your App Store account settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a submission.
Terms of Use: https://prismlensapps.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://prismlensapps.com/privacy

bluejetty:00015038:ios.description:
Bible Coloring Book for Kids is a truly free Christian Coloring and Bible Games app made especially for children. Kids can Color Bible pictures, play Memory Games and solve Jigsaw Puzzles while discovering stories about God, Jesus and the Bible!
The app includes beautiful Bible illustrations from the Old and New Testament and offers a calm, simple and child-friendly experience for families, churches, Sunday school, Bible school and children’s ministry.
## Bible Coloring, Memory and Puzzles
Children can enjoy three fun activities in one app:
* Coloring beautiful Bible scenes and Christian pictures
* Playing memory games with Bible-themed images
* Solving jigsaw puzzles with meaningful Christian illustrations
Each activity is designed to be simple, peaceful and enjoyable for kids.
## Made for Children and Families
Bible Coloring Book for Kids helps children learn about Bible stories in a joyful and creative way. While coloring and playing, children can discover Christian themes and create natural conversations with parents, grandparents and teachers about God, Jesus, faith, kindness, prayer and the Word of God.
The app is a great choice for:
* Christian families
* Parents and grandparents
* Sunday school
* Bible school
* Children’s ministry
* Church activities
* Quiet creative time at home
* Faith-based learning for kids
## Key Features
* Bible coloring pages for kids
* Beautiful pictures from the Old and New Testament
* Coloring, Memory and Jigsaw Puzzle games
* Freehand drawing mode with border protection
* Tap-to-fill coloring mode
* Erase mode and full page reset
* Save and share children’s artwork
* Relaxing background music
* Simple child-friendly interface
* No ads
* No in-app purchases
* Works on iPhone, iPad and iPod touch
## Benefits for Children
* Encourages creativity and imagination
* Helps improve focus and concentration
* Supports hand-eye coordination
* Helps develop fine motor skills
* Introduces children to Bible stories in a fun way
* Creates opportunities for conversations about faith
## Loved by Families and Churches

“My grandkids absolutely love this game. They play it every time they come to visit.” — TripleAMom2
“The kids at my church absolutely love coloring and learning about Jesus.” — KateyLynn'15

Bible Coloring Book for Kids is a truly free Christian Coloring and Bible Games app made especially for children. Kids can Color Bible pictures, play Memory Games and solve Jigsaw Puzzles while discovering stories about God, Jesus and the Bible!

The app includes beautiful Bible illustrations from the Old and New Testament and offers a calm, simple and child-friendly experience for families, churches, Sunday school, Bible school and children’s ministry.

## Bible Coloring, Memory and Puzzles

Children can enjoy three fun activities in one app:
* Coloring beautiful Bible scenes and Christian pictures
* Playing memory games with Bible-themed images
* Solving jigsaw puzzles with meaningful Christian illustrations

Each activity is designed to be simple, peaceful and enjoyable for kids.

## Made for Children and Families

Bible Coloring Book for Kids helps children learn about Bible stories in a joyful and creative way. While coloring and playing, children can discover Christian themes and create natural conversations with parents, grandparents and teachers about God, Jesus, faith, kindness, prayer and the Word of God.

The app is a great choice for:
* Christian families
* Parents and grandparents
* Sunday school
* Bible school
* Children’s ministry
* Church activities
* Quiet creative time at home
* Faith-based learning for kids

## Key Features

* Bible coloring pages for kids
* Beautiful pictures from the Old and New Testament
* Coloring, Memory and Jigsaw Puzzle games
* Freehand drawing mode with border protection
* Tap-to-fill coloring mode
* Erase mode and full page reset
* Save and share children’s artwork
* Relaxing background music
* Simple child-friendly interface
* No ads
* No in-app purchases
* Works on iPhone, iPad and iPod touch

## Benefits for Children

* Encourages creativity and imagination
* Helps improve focus and concentration
* Supports hand-eye coordination
* Helps develop fine motor skills
* Introduces children to Bible stories in a fun way
* Creates opportunities for conversations about faith

## Loved by Families and Churches

“Bible stories come alive. So much fun, yet educational.” — Diana deer

“My grandkids absolutely love this game. They play it every time they come to visit.” — TripleAMom2

“The kids at my church absolutely love coloring and learning about Jesus.” — KateyLynn'15

“Everything is so vibrant and colorful.” — Fher96

Download Bible Coloring Book for Kids and give children a joyful way to explore Bible stories through coloring, memory games and puzzles!

bluejetty:00046704:ios.name: CondoSócio
bluejetty:00046704:ios.summary: O CondoSócio vai muito além de uma ferramenta de gestão condominial. Ele é uma plataforma completa e integradora, desenvolvida para oferecer mais segurança, praticidade e eficiência na rotina de condomínios, moradores, visitantes e equipes
bluejetty:00046704:ios.description:
O CondoSócio vai muito além de uma ferramenta de gestão condominial. Ele é uma plataforma completa e integradora, desenvolvida para oferecer mais segurança, praticidade e eficiência na rotina de condomínios, moradores, visitantes e equipes de portaria.
Com recursos avançados de controle de acesso e integração com dispositivos de reconhecimento facial, o CondoSócio torna o processo de entrada e saída muito mais ágil, seguro e inteligente. A identificação e autorização de visitantes, prestadores de serviços e moradores acontecem de forma simples, fluida e confiável, reforçando a segurança e garantindo que apenas pessoas autorizadas tenham acesso ao condomínio.
Para os moradores, a experiência também está ainda melhor. Com poucos toques no aplicativo, é possível autorizar visitantes, acompanhar acessos, solicitar serviços, realizar reservas e interagir com as funcionalidades do condomínio de forma rápida e intuitiva.
E agora, com a nova atualização, o CondoSócio apresenta um novo estilo visual, mais moderno, organizado e agradável de usar, proporcionando uma navegação ainda mais clara e eficiente. Além disso, o app passa a contar também com o cadastro de pets, um novo recurso pensado para trazer mais praticidade ao dia a dia dos moradores e fortalecer a gestão das informações dentro do condomínio.
Essa evolução reforça o compromisso do CondoSócio em inovar continuamente, oferecendo soluções que unem tecnologia, segurança e comodidade em uma única plataforma. Mais do que acompanhar a rotina condominial, o aplicativo transforma a experiência de viver e administrar condomínios de forma mais inteligente, conectada e segura.

bluejetty:00034929:ios.name: Suzerain
bluejetty:00034929:ios.summary: Step into the fictional Suzerain Universe, a narrative-driven political series from Torpor Games, that explores the complex world of political leadership and decision-making. Whether you take on the role of President in Sordland or King in
bluejetty:00034929:ios.description:
Step into the fictional Suzerain Universe, a narrative-driven political series from Torpor Games, that explores the complex world of political leadership and decision-making. Whether you take on the role of President in Sordland or King in Rizia, your choices will shape history. Navigate complex decisions and guide your people through pivotal moments across an epic 1.5m-word branching political saga.
Please note: Suzerain is only available in the English language. 
REPUBLIC OF SORDLAND: Assume the role of President Anton Rayne and guide the nation of Sordland through the challenging times of your first term. Every choice you make has consequences in a world of corruption, political intrigue, economic recession, and international conflict. Will you bring reform, or will you fall into the traps of the past? How will you lead? 
KINGDOM OF RIZIA: Take on the mantle of King Romus Toras and lead Rizia through the challenges of your reign. Your decisions impact shifting alliances, noble rivalries, economic hurdles, and looming threats. Will you restore Rizia's glory through diplomacy or expand its borders by force? Engage with powerful nobles, manage resources, and navigate the complex web of politics. How will you reign? 
Experience the Suzerain Universe: 
- Play with Ads: Access the entire game with ads at the end of each turn. 
- Premium Ownership: Players can purchase individual story packs (Sordland and Rizia). Premium players have full access to their purchased story packs with extra perks such as story points on purchase, and no ads. 
- Subscription System: Enjoy Suzerain content without ads with flexible subscription plans ranging from 1-day to 1-month passes. Subscribers gain timed access to both the Republic of Sordland and Kingdom of Rizia story packs. 
- Lifetime Pass: For dedicated fans, the Lifetime Pass offers full access to all current and future content in the Suzerain Universe, with no ads and forever. This includes any future DLC and additional story packs, providing the ultimate premium experience.
REPUBLIC OF SORDLAND FEATURES: 
Decisions Matter: Make critical decisions on security, economy, welfare, and diplomacy. Your values will be tested beyond the confines of your office. 
Build Your Legacy: Drive Sordland towards one of 9 unique major endings and more than 25 sub-endings. What will your legacy be? 
Duty vs. Personal Values: Witness how your presidential decisions influence the country and your family and relationships. 
Manage the Recession: Take control of the nation's budget and economic growth, and strive to bring Sordland out of an ongoing recession. 
Pass Reforms: Work with politicians to amend the constitution, and sign or veto bills into law. 
KINGDOM OF RIZIA FEATURES: 
New Kingdom, New King: Assume the role of King Romus, the newly crowned leader of the Kingdom of Rizia. Explore South Merkopa, an expansion of the Suzerain Universe.
Geopolitical Challenges & New Resources: Start dialogues with new national leaders. Will you forge new alliances or make new enemies? Oversee the management of new invaluable resources such as energy and authority. 
A Game of Houses: Engage in discussions on religion, family, and romance. Dive into the intricate dynamics of a royal family and houses where relationships intertwine, merging the realms of love, duty, and politics. 
Build Your Nation: Sign dozens of Royal Decrees on topics such as order, economy, and welfare to develop and improve Rizia. Will you be the guardian of peace or the catalyst for conflict? 
War Mechanic & Military Build-up: Experience the strategic and tactical military challenges in a turn-based experience. Build up the Rizian Armed Forces and train units to intimidate neighbors. 
Rich Character Interactions: Encounter a diverse cast of 20+ characters each with unique backgrounds and motivations. 
The fate of nations rests in your hands. Are you ready to lead?

bluejetty:00026194:ios.name: Distance Tool
bluejetty:00026194:ios.summary: Distance Tool allows for quick and easy calculations to find distances between points on a map, including area calculations for non-overlapping polygons drawn. Includes metric (meters, kilometers) and imperial units (yards, miles, feet for
bluejetty:00026194:ios.description:
Distance Tool allows for quick and easy calculations to find distances between points on a map, including area calculations for non-overlapping polygons drawn. Includes metric (meters, kilometers) and imperial units (yards, miles, feet for altitude) for distances. Co-ordinates can either be displayed in decimal or degrees, meters and seconds.
Useful for mapping fields in agriculture, plots of land/home boundaries, or for general interest in distances and areas!
Functionality to drop a point at your current location (GPS or otherwise), and to email the results. Tap briefly to drop points anywhere on the map.
Share your drawing (shape) by email, which includes a file that can be opened on any device with Distance Tool.
Allows the standard map views of standard, satellite and hybrid.
Supports quick altitude calculation without data connectivity. Find out how high up you are! Or see the altitude of ANY point (requires data).
Freehand draw: Draw any shape on the map to quickly calculate area.
Follow Mode: Calculate distance or areas simply by moving!
Subscription terms:
- The subscription auto-renews at the end of each term.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
- You may manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase.
Privacy policy and Terms of Use: https://applorium.com/privacy-distance-tool

bluejetty:00018000:ios.name: Highland Bank
bluejetty:00018000:ios.summary: Highland Bank is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by
bluejetty:00018000:ios.description:
Highland Bank is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Highland Bank:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes, and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Highland Bank app, you must be enrolled as a Highland Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and log in with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00040573:ios.summary: Nutrilio is the ultimate calorie counter and macro tracker powered by AI, designed to make food tracking simple, fast, and effective. Take control of your health by snapping a quick photo of your meal, and Nutrilio’s advanced AI instantly c
bluejetty:00040573:ios.description:
Nutrilio is the ultimate calorie counter and macro tracker powered by AI, designed to make food tracking simple, fast, and effective. Take control of your health by snapping a quick photo of your meal, and Nutrilio’s advanced AI instantly calculates calories, macros (carbs, fats, and proteins), and more. Whether your goal is weight loss, muscle building, or simply improving your overall nutrition, Nutrilio is the perfect companion for achieving your goals.
Tracking what you eat has never been easier. Nutrilio’s AI-powered calorie counter allows you to analyze your meals in seconds, providing detailed insights into the nutritional content of your food. Forget the hassle of manually logging every ingredient—Nutrilio does it for you, so you can focus on building healthier habits.
Nutrilio is more than a calorie counter. It is a complete nutrition tracker designed for anyone who wants to monitor their diet, track macros, and achieve health goals. The app adapts to your lifestyle, providing valuable insights and trends that help you make better food choices every day.
WHY CHOOSE NUTRILIO?
Nutrilio combines powerful tools with simplicity to help you achieve your nutrition goals. Its AI-driven food tracker ensures fast, accurate calorie and macro tracking, making it easy for you to:
- Analyze meals and understand your calorie intake
- Track macros (carbs, fats, and proteins) for a balanced diet
- Set and monitor goals like weight loss, maintenance, or muscle gain
- Build sustainable habits with reminders and insights
HOW DOES NUTRILIO WORK?
1. Snap a photo of your food, and Nutrilio’s AI instantly analyzes the meal, calculating calories and providing a detailed macro breakdown.
2. Track additional factors like water intake, fasting hours, or fitness goals.
3. Set daily reminders to log meals, stay hydrated, and remain consistent with your goals.
4. Monitor your progress with intuitive charts and trends that highlight your calorie consumption and macro balance.
Nutrilio’s focus on macros makes it ideal for anyone following a diet that emphasizes carb, fat, and protein intake, whether it’s for weight loss, muscle building, or overall health improvement.
TOP FEATURES OF NUTRILIO:
- AI-powered calorie counter for quick and accurate food tracking
- Advanced macro tracker to analyze carbs, fats, and proteins
- Goal-setting tools to support weight loss, muscle gain, or balanced eating
- Water tracker and fasting reminders for complete nutrition monitoring
- Personalized insights to help you reflect on your eating habits and improve
ADDITIONAL FEATURES:
- Over 30 customizable categories for tracking food, water, fasting, and more
- Visualize your progress with charts and detailed trends
- Set hydration goals with the integrated water tracker
- Monitor your fasting hours to stay aligned with your diet plan
- Export your data for sharing with professionals or further analysis
Nutrilio stands out by combining the power of a calorie counter and macro tracker into one app. It helps you monitor not only calories but also the breakdown of carbs, fats, and proteins, giving you the full picture of your nutrition. Whether you want to lose weight, improve your diet, or maintain your current fitness level, Nutrilio makes tracking your food and nutrition effortless.
Nutrilio’s AI simplifies food analysis, allowing you to save time and focus on achieving your health goals. You can set personalized goals, track progress with charts, and gain valuable insights into your diet and habits. It’s the ultimate tool for staying on top of your health, whether you’re starting your journey or looking for advanced tracking features.
READY TO TAKE CONTROL OF YOUR DIET?
Nutrilio helps you track calories, monitor macros, and crush your nutrition goals. Download now and join thousands of users transforming their health with Nutrilio.
---

bluejetty:00024284:ios.summary: Spades Masters is a modern spin on the classic card game, for fans of Hearts, Bridge, Euchre, Gin Rummy, and Tarneeb. Play with friends, enjoy daily rewards, and personalize your spades experience with unique card decks. Play through a vari
bluejetty:00024284:ios.description:
Spades Masters is a modern spin on the classic card game, for fans of Hearts, Bridge, Euchre, Gin Rummy, and Tarneeb. Play with friends, enjoy daily rewards, and personalize your spades experience with unique card decks. Play through a variety of game modes, from solo challenges to team battles, and climb the leaderboard as you master the art of Spades. Whether you’re a seasoned player or new to the game, Spades Masters offers a fun and strategic experience!
== EXPERIENCE THE BEST OF SPADES IN ONE APP ==
• Various Game Modes: Whether you prefer the classic team play, going solo, or challenging yourself in our special events, Spades Masters has something for everyone.
• Competitive Challenges: Participate in our regular Spades events and knock-out challenges, where strategy and skill lead to amazing prizes.
• Build a Vibrant Community: Invite your friends to grow your Spades Ambassador profile and supercharge your daily rewards.
• Customize Your Game: Choose from an array of card decks you can win to personalize your Spades experience. Stand out in every match with your unique style. Complete challenges to unlock incredible new deck designs.
• Free Daily Bonuses: Play more with our daily rewards system, giving you the freedom to join higher stakes games and increase your chances of winning.
== ENJOY THE BEST CLASSIC CARD GAME FEATURES ==
• Dynamic Leaderboards: Track your progress and see how you rank against the world’s best
Spades players.
• Balanced & Fair Play: Our advanced AI ensures a balanced card game for players of all skill levels, making every game fair and challenging.
• Guest Mode: Prefer to stay under the radar? Join anonymously and enjoy Spades with no strings attached.
• Sophisticated Design: Optimized for all devices, Spades Masters boasts stunning graphics and smooth gameplay, enhancing your experience.
• Continually Improving: We’re dedicated to constantly improving the game, with regular updates driven by player feedback and the latest in gaming technology.

bluejetty:00014075:ios.description:
EZOfficeInventory is an asset tracking software designed to simplify
asset management, ensuring you know where your assets are and who they are assigned
to. Assign barcodes to assets and scan to check in and check out items. Minimize loss and
save time and effort! 
Its advanced inventory management features enable monitoring and tracking asset
movement in different locations and maintaining an accurate record of what’s where. Now
you can track assets throughout their lifecycle and also get real-time performance updates
so you know when to repair, refurbish, or retire assets. 
The EZOfficeInventory app provides actionable insights to empower your decision-making.
With reliable asset information, you can run assessment reports to identify bottlenecks and
eliminate inefficient practices. 
Key features:  
- Maintain a record of all critical item information through barcode scans, identification
numbers, and computerized AINs. 
- Use the availability calendar to view which items are available, checked out, and in
service. This helps with conflict-free reservations, scheduling service sessions, and
simplifying workflows. 
- Run automated purchase order management and ensure optimal stock levels at all
times. Manage costs, vendor details, and inventory in a centralized information hub.
- Enter locations and sub-locations and link them to relevant assets, asset stock, and
inventory. Easily track asset movements as soon as they are added to or checked
out of a location. 
- Maintain a history trail of all asset actions taken by users in EZOfficeInventory. 
- Cater to business requirements by using advanced customization in the app. Create
custom fields, rename items, and populate custom roles to accommodate your
workflows. 
- Experience easy fixed asset management. Calculate depreciation and receive
notifications every time an asset is about to expire to dispose of it on time. 
- Manage teams by assigning user roles, and associate them to assets for verified
custodianship. 
- Send out alerts for asset checkouts, member offboarding, service initiation, asset
retirement, and more to notify team members anywhere, anytime. 
About EZOfficeInventory
EZOfficeInventory is a powerful asset management software built to track and optimize your
physical assets. Easily control ownership, procurement, and service of all items across their
lifecycle and maintain reliable real-time data for asset operations. Achieve higher productivity
and efficiency!
EZOfficeInventory is the leading asset tracking software used by 1000s of businesses.
IMPORTANT: 
1. Requires an EZOfficeInventory (PAID) account. For details visit EZOfficeInventory webpage
2. Access to your Location is required for reporting geolocation of asset barcode scans

Water Sort Puzzle is a fun and relaxing water sort puzzle on mobile. Try to sort the watercolor in the glasses until all colors in the same happy glass. A challenging yet relaxing game to exercise your brain!
How to Play Water Sort Puzzle
- Tap any glass to pour and sort its water color into another.
- You can only pour if both glasses match and there’s space to fill the cup.
- Think carefully before each move - bad planning can create a jam.
- Restart freely if you get stuck.
- Complete the level by finishing the water sort puzzle and making each cup a single color.
Water Sort Puzzle Features
- Addictive water sort gameplay that never gets boring.
- Hundreds of levels with unique designs and rising difficulty.
- Fully playable as a water sort offline color game - play anywhere, anytime.
- Bright, smooth, and relaxing animations.
- Inspired by the fun of happy glass, waterpark sort, and magic sort challenges.
- Simple one-finger tap controls to pour and sort the color.
- Engaging mechanics with water color sort, color fill, and fill the cup challenges.
Designed for fans of puzzle games and sorting games, this colorful logic experience will test your brain while keeping you calm. If you enjoy solving tricky levels, separating colors, and watching every glass fill perfectly, then Water Sort Puzzle is the ultimate game for you.
Your goal is simple yet satisfying: pour and sort the water color into their correct glasses. Each move matters, and every level is a brain teasing puzzle waiting to be solved. This isn’t just a typical puzzle game, it’s a clever water sort puzzle designed for players who love strategy and logic. And because it's a water sort offline color game, you can enjoy it anytime, anywhere.
Why You’ll Love It
What makes Water Sort Puzzle special is its perfect mix of relaxation and brain-teasing fun. It’s more than just a water game - it’s a logical, satisfying, and endlessly replayable challenge. Early levels teach you the basics of water sort, but soon you’ll face advanced water sort puzzles with more glasses, tricky layouts, and complex strategies.
Fans of happy glass will enjoy the smooth pouring physics. Lovers of waterpark sort and magic sort puzzles will appreciate the creative twists. And players searching for a relaxing water sort offline color game will find hours of fun with no internet needed.
Every level feels like solving a colorful riddle. As you sort the color and fill the cup, you’ll sharpen your focus, patience, and problem-solving skills. Whether you call it water sort, water color sort, or simply a fun water sort challenge, this game is made to keep you entertained.
Play It for the Holidays
Water Sort Puzzle is also a perfect holiday friendly game you can enjoy with family and friends. Whether you're relaxing at home, sharing challenges together, or taking cozy breaks during the season, this puzzle feels festive and fun for all ages.
If you're searching for a Halloween game, a free Halloween game, or simply games with Halloween themes to enjoy during the holidays, Water Sort Puzzle offers a relaxing, exciting experience that fits the season.
Who Can Play Water Sort Puzzle
This game is perfect for:
- Anyone who enjoys water sort and water sort puzzle games.
- Players looking for the best water sort offline color game.
- Fans of sorting games, water color sort, and magic sort challenges.

apple-itunes:1349015402.name: SELPHY Photo Layout
apple-itunes:1349015402.description:
SELPHY Photo Layout is an application that allows you to create/save layouts of images to be printed with SELPHY using images stored on your smartphone or tablet.
[Key Features]
- Connect your smartphone or tablet wirelessly with SELPHY printers and enjoy high-quality photo printing.
 ("Canon PRINT" must be installed separately for CP1300, CP1200, CP910, and CP900.)
- Easily print photos directly from the ‘Photos’ menu.
- Decorate and layout your photos freely with the ‘Collage’ menu before printing.
[Supported Products]
SELPHY CP Series
- CP1500, CP1300, CP1200, CP910, CP900*
SELPHY QX Series
- QX20, SQUARE QX10
[System requirement]
- iOS 17/18/26
- iPadOS 17/18/26
[Supported Images]
- JPEG, PNG, HEIF
[Supported Layouts / Functions ]
SELPHY CP Series
- Photos (Easily print an unmodified original photo)
- Collage (Have fun decorating or arranging multiple photos before you print)
- ID Photo (Print ID photos such as passport and driver’s license pictures from selfies.)
- Shuffle (Select up to 20 images, and they will be automatically arranged and printed on one sheet.)
- Custom Size (Print in any photo size)
- Tiling (split the photo into multiple tiles to print large)
- Snap a shot (Take a photo on the spot, decorate, and print)
- Bookmark (Print in a bookmark-style layout)
- Layout (Simply choose a photo to combine with a frame and print)
- Reprint (Print additional copies from your previously printed collection.)
- Collage Decoration Features (Include stamps, frames, text, paint tools, and embedded QR codes.)
- Pattern Overcoat Processing (Only for CP1500).
SELPHY QX Series
- Photos (Easily print an unmodified original photo)
- Collage (Have fun decorating or arranging multiple photos before you print)
- Custom Size (Print in any photo size)
- Snap a shot (Take a photo on the spot, decorate, and print)
- Layout (Simply choose a photo to combine with a frame and print)
- Reprint (Print additional copies from your previously printed collection.)
- Collage Decoration Features (Include stamps, frames, and text.)
- Pattern Overcoat Processing.
- Card & Square Hybrid Printing / Borderless & Bordered Printing (Only for QX20).
[Supported Paper Size]
- All available SELPHY-specific paper sizes for purchase *1
SELPHY CP Series
- Postcard Size
- L (3R) Size
- Card Size
SELPHY QX Series
- Square Sticker Paper for QX.
- Card Sticker Paper for QX (Only for QX20).
*1: availability may differ depending on region.
[Important Notes]
- If application does not operate properly, try again after shutting down the application.
- Features and services available in this application may differ depending on the model, country or region, and environment.
- Visit your local Canon Web pages for more details.
* CP900 does not support printing in ad-hoc mode with "Canon Print". Please use it in infrastructure mode.
